phases.objective: Expose a bounded read-only Production Recovery authority preflight through the existing Production activation-readiness evidence without loading the deployment-owned authority module or touching the Recovery control database.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Readiness evidence identifies explicit runtime, binding-module, production-live-mode, control-store configuration, and unresolved authority-graph blockers while activation remains ineligible and zero mutation is performed.
steps: Resolve strict Production runtime identity without provider access.
Read server-managed binding status without loading the configured deployment module.
Validate only the presence of independent Recovery control-store configuration without opening a database connection.
Return the complete Recovery component inventory and activation-critical live-authority subset.
Keep production_authority_graph_resolution_required blocking until the deployment-owned graph is separately resolved and certified.
Embed the bounded preflight in the existing Production activation-readiness response.
assertions: Missing deployment-owned binding module remains blocked.
Any binding mode other than production_live remains blocked.
Missing independent Recovery control-store configuration remains blocked.
The deployment module is not loaded by this preflight.
No database connection, approval issuance, execution-ticket issuance, provider access, workflow dispatch, deployment, or Production mutation is performed.
Database host, user, password, name and module path are never returned.

phases.objective: Keep Production Recovery live activation blocked until a provisioned independent Recovery control store and complete certified deployment-owned authority graph exist.
